shots.description: The player races south through Downtown Solmara at 93 KM/H with 3 wanted stars, a police cruiser alongside and a helicopter overhead. Mission card, minimap with route line, speed and condition readout all visible.
shots.title: Police chase at golden hour

shots.description: Third-person street view at spawn: the player on 0th Street with traffic, pedestrians, lit mid-rise buildings and the sunset sky. Minimap shows the route to the first mission marker.
shots.title: On foot in Downtown Solmara

shots.description: The first mission's dialogue: Lina at the glowing mission marker on the Marina plaza, with the beach, palms and sea behind her. Dialogue box, mission card and district label visible.
shots.title: Meeting Lina at the Marina
